search_patents.description: Search Google Patents and extract top results (title, patent number, assignee, date, abstract, PDF link).

query.description: Search query (supports Google Patents syntax, e.g. keywords or `country:CN`).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to extract (1-100, default 10).

country.description: Optional country filter appended to the query (e.g. "CN", "US", "EP").

returns.description: Array of {title, number, country, inventors, assignee, dates, abstract, url, pdfUrl} objects.

get_patent_document.description: Open a Google Patents detail page and extract title, abstract, claims, and description text.

patentNumber.description: Patent number, e.g. "CN110515732B" or full URL "https://patents.google.com/patent/CN110515732B/zh".

returns.description: Object with title, number, abstract, claims, description.

download_patent_pdf.description: Download a patent PDF from Google Patents to a local directory.

outputDir.description: Output directory for the PDF (default: current working directory).

extract_pdf_link.description: Extract the PDF download link from the current Google Patents result page.

returns.description: The PDF URL, or empty string.
